decisive_counterexample.claim: The standard 7D octonionic cross product is equivariant under the full SO(7) group.

prior_art_boundary: The imaginary-octonion cross product and its G2 symmetry group are imported/known mathematics. This is a counterexample artifact, not a novelty claim.
pdt_consequence: The n=7 normed-cross-product branch cannot satisfy full SO(7) covariance. Full SO(n) covariance would eliminate n=7, but PDT has not derived that premise non-circularly.
next_obligation: Derive or falsify full SO(n) covariance and vector-valued alternating closure from PDT primitives without cross-product, Hodge-star, or dimension-matching assumptions.
